SELECT id,md5(to_jsonb(p)::text) AS source_row_md5 FROM public.plusfresc_products p WHERE (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)|b[ií]fidus' OR category_id IN ('020101','020102') OR category_id LIKE '0404%'))
      AND id COLLATE "C" > '' COLLATE "C" ORDER BY id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 500
